_note: Generated from DCAT-AP-UK. Names match the metadata weaver, so records written by the weaver load into these definitions. Not tested against a live tenant. Set with the REST catalog's table properties; values are strings, with lists and objects written as JSON. A table description goes in the comment property.

properties.dcat_ap_uk.title: The name of the resource, in plain English.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.description: A plain English account of what the resource contains and what it can be used for.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.identifier: The main identifier of the resource in the publisher's own catalogue.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.publisher: The organisation responsible for making the resource available.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.contactPoint: Where to ask questions about the resource or give feedback on it.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.accessRights: Who can get the data, and on what terms.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.securityClassification: The classification under the Government Security Classifications Policy that the data itself carries.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.licence: The licence under which the resource can be used.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.accrualPeriodicity: How often the resource is updated.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.criticalDataAsset: Whether the resource is a critical data asset under the Data Asset Management Policy.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.creator: The organisation that created or compiled the content of the resource.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.created: The date the content of the resource was created or compiled.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.conformsTo: A standard, specification or schema the resource follows.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.temporal: The period of time the data is about.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.personalData: Whether the data contains information about identifiable living people, and in what form.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.rights: A statement of any restriction on access or use, such as the data sharing agreement or legal gateway needed.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.modified: The date the content of the resource last changed.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.issued: The date the resource was first made available.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.abstract: A one-sentence summary of the resource, of no more than 250 characters.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.theme: The broad subject of the resource, from a controlled list.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.keyword: Words or short phrases that people might search for, not already in the title or description.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.spatial: The geographic area the data is about.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.distribution: A form in which the data can be got, such as a file or an API.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.landingPage: A web page where people can find out about the resource and how to get it.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.sensitiveData: Whether the data contains information that needs extra care beyond being personal, such as special category data.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.qualifiedAttribution: An organisation and the role it plays for the resource, such as data owner or data steward.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.language: The language or languages of the resource.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.alternative: Another name the resource is known by, such as an abbreviation or a former name.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.otherIdentifier: Any other identifier the resource is known by, such as one in a national or sector register.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.inSeries: The dataset series this dataset belongs to.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.isReplacedBy: A newer resource that replaces this one.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.expires: The date after which the resource should no longer be used.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.previousVersion: The version this one replaces in a sequence.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.spatialResolutionInMeters: The smallest distance the data can tell apart, in metres.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.temporalResolution: The smallest period the data can tell apart, as an ISO 8601 duration.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.referenceData: A code list, classification or set of groupings the data uses, such as age bands or a geography.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.qualityAnnotation: A link to a published statement or measurement of the quality of the data.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.relation: Another resource closely related to this one, such as the report the data supports.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.qualifiedRelation: A related resource together with the kind of relationship.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.documentation: A web page that documents the resource, such as a user guide or a methodology.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.metadataAudience: Who is allowed to see the metadata record itself.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.applicableLegislation: Legislation that requires, governs or permits the publication or sharing of the resource.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.hasPolicy: A machine-readable policy, in the W3C Open Digital Rights Language (ODRL), saying what may and may not be done with the resource.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.jurisdiction: Every country or territory where the data is stored or processed, or to which it is sent.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.transferMechanism: The basis under UK GDPR on which personal data in the resource may be sent outside the UK.
properties.dcat_ap_uk.missingValue: A property this record leaves empty on purpose, and why.
